title: Just Love Fashion Recalls Children's Pajama Pants Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The children's pajama pants fail to meet the flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,400.

title: Nature's Truth Recalls Wintergreen Essential Oil Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirements
summary: The bottles are not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act, posing a poisoning risk if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 22,100.

title: The Company Store Recalls Girl's Pajama Sets Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The pajama sets fail to meet the federal flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 2,500.

title: Electric Bicycles Recalled by Faraday; Seat Post Poses Fall Hazard
summary: The seat post on the bicycles can break, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 4,450.

title: SRAM Recalls RockShox Front Suspension Forks Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The fork's lower leg assembly can break and cause the rider to lose control, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 840 (In addition, about 80 were sold in Canada).

title: Factory Direct Wholesale Recalls Folding Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,500.

title: Bodum Recalls Toasters Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The recalled toasters can leak electric current when operating at the maximum normal temperature, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,400 (In addition, about 1,480 in Canada).

title: K2 Sports Recalls Inline Skates Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The skate axle can become loose or a portion of the axle can sheer off during use resulting in a wheel separating from the skate's frame, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,700 pairs of skates (in addition, about 740 pairs were sold in Canada).

title: VIVO Recalls Speaker Wall Mounts Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The ledge on the front of the speaker wall mount can loosen, allowing both the ledge and the speakers to fall, posing an injury hazard to bystanders Units: About 2,400.

title: Wintergreen Essential Oil Recalled by Epic Business Services Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they ingest it. Units: About 11,580.

title: Levolor Recalls Custom Cellular Shades Due to Strangulation Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The pull cords are joined by a non-breakaway cord connector, which poses a strangulation hazard for small children. Units: About 30,000.

title: Lidl Recalls Wooden Grasping Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wooden wheels can detach and release small parts, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 300.

title: Lifetime Brands Recalls Fitz and Floyd Nevaeh White Can Mugs Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards
summary: The mugs can crack or break when used with or exposed to hot liquids, posing burn and laceration hazards. Units: About 150,000 (In addition about 3,500 in Canada).

title: Bose Recalls EdgeMax® and FreeSpace® Loudspeakers Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The loudspeaker's mounting components can break causing the speakers to dislodge and fall from its installed location, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 77,500.

title: Custom Molded Products Recalls Valve Caps Sold With Hot Tubs/Swim Spas Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The valve cap on the hot tubs and swim spas can become loose, pop off and strike a bystander, posing an impact hazard. Units: About 16,000.

title: Everbilt Door Pulls Recalled Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot; Made by Wellsco International Group
summary: The door pulls can have sharp edges on the back, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 70,200.

title: Office Depot Recalls Desks Due To Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The desk's control box has an electrical issue resulting in reverse polarity, which could pose a shock hazard. Units: About 19,000.

title: Universal Security Instruments Recalls to Inspect Smoke Alarms Due to Risk of Failure to Alert Consumers to a Fire
summary: The smoke alarms can have a misaligned internal switch causing the alarms to not activate properly, posing a risk of failure to alert consumers to a fire. Units: About 180,000.

title: Winco Fireworks Recalls Black Cat "Cat Mobiles" Due to Explosion, Burn and Projectile Hazards
summary: When ignited, the device can burst and spread sparks and pyrotechnic materials upward and outward instead of on the ground as intended, posing explosion, burn and projectile hazards to bystanders. Units: About 21,000.

title: Swaddle Bee Recalls Children's Security Blankets Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The blanket's snaps can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 700.

title: Disney Recalls the Forky 11" Plush Toy Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The "googly" plastic eyes on the toy can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 80,000 (In addition, about 650 in Canada).

title: Dorel Juvenile Group USA Recalls Inclined Sleepers Due to Safety Concerns About Inclined Sleep Products
summary: Infant fatalities have been reported while using other inclined sleep products, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side while unrestrained, or under other circumstances. Units: About 24,000.

title: London Bridge Recalls Sock and Wrist Rattle Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Rattles sewn inside the socks and wristbands can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 7,500.

title: Tristar Products Recalls Magnetic Trivets Due to Magnet Ingestion Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Magnets can detach from the trivets, posing an ingestion hazard to children. title: Spansive Recalls Wireless Phone Chargers Due To Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Metallic accessories attached to phones placed on the chargers can overheat while phones charge, posing a burn hazard to users Units: About 950.

title: Britax Recalls Modified Thru-Bolt Axles for Use with BOB Jogging Strollers Distributed Through the BOB Information Campaign Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The modified thru-bolt on the front wheel can fracture, allowing the wheel to detach from the stroller, posing fall and injury hazards to children in the stroller and adults operating the stroller. Units: About 200.

title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Cannondale CAADX Cyclocross Bicycles Due to Fall and Serious Injury Hazard; One Fatality Reported
summary: The fork can break, posing a fall hazard with the risk of death and serious injury. Units: About 9,700 (in addition, about 1,900 were sold in Canada).

title: H&M Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's pajama sets fail to meet the flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 9,000.

title: Stokke Recalls Infant Steps Bouncers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The Stokke Steps Bouncer can detach from the Stokke Steps Chair, posing a fall hazard to the child in the Bouncer. Units: About 5,400.

title: Porter Cable Table Saws Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Made by Chang Type
summary: The motor can overheat, creating a fire hazard. Units: About 258,000 (in addition, about 990 were sold in Canada).

title: Trek Recalls Kickster Bikes Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The steer tube clamp on the bike can break, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 11,560 (In addition, 1,800 were sold in Canada).

title: The Boppy Company Recalls Infant Head and Neck Support Accessories Due to Suffocation Hazard
summary: The head support area can be overstuffed and cause the infant's head to be tilted too far forward, posing a suffocation hazard Units: 14000.
